comment: Third-party SERVICES OBAF loads only when configured (analytics, captcha, feedback widgets, in-context translation). They are not libraries a page needs, they call home after loading, and the sealed stack enables none of them; mirror.py does not mirror them and the route handler aborts them as 'excluded'. Match = substring of the https URL.

exclude.reason: reCAPTCHA on the self-signup page (auth/signup.gsp): a Google service, not a library
HelpScout Beacon help widget, only when openboxes.helpscout.widget.enabled
UserVoice feedback widget, only when openboxes.uservoice.widget.enabled
Crowdin in-context translation, only in localization (debug locale) mode
Google Analytics gtag, only when tracking ids are configured
